prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide decorative background for a child's ENT appointment page in Envitefy, landscape 1536x1024. Create an original, gentle editorial illustration appropriate for a seven-year-old child. Light warm ivory and pale mint paper background. At the outer corners and edges, a friendly rounded teal otoscope, a small softly drawn ear with curved listening waves, simple colorful building blocks, a few small stars and a paper airplane. Medical objects must feel reassuring and recognizable, with no procedure, needles, sharp tools, clinical distress or anatomical detail. Sophisticated soft gouache with subtle paper grain, teal, sage, butter yellow and soft blue accents; no gender stereotypes, no baby imagery. Keep the broad center and upper-left middle extremely quiet and light so large dark event text and white logistics cards remain readable. No people, names, numbers, letters, logos, dates, documents or text anywhere. This is only the background artwork, no UI, no cards or buttons.
verified: WebP codec and original dimensions confirmed with ffprobe; successfully decoded with FFmpeg. Generated PNG original deleted after verification.
